# SportLogic Virtuals API Examples

![Kiron Compatible](https://img.shields.io/badge/Kiron-Compatible-brightgreen)
![Data Feed](https://img.shields.io/badge/Data_Feed-Live-blue)
![8 Game Types](https://img.shields.io/badge/Game_Types-8-orange)

Code samples for the [SportLogic Virtuals API](https://virtuals-api.sportlogic.io) — virtual horse/greyhound racing, motor racing, and more.

Product and pricing: **[sportlogic.io](https://sportlogic.io)** · Full reference: [API docs](https://virtuals-api.sportlogic.io/docs) · Sign up: [dashboard.sportlogic.io](https://dashboard.sportlogic.io)

## Quick Start

1. Register for a free API key -- the endpoint is POST-only, so run:
   ```bash
   curl -X POST https://virtuals-api.sportlogic.io/api/v1/register \
     -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
     -d '{"name":"Your Name","email":"you@example.com"}'
   ```
2. Pick your language below
3. Set your API key and run

## Examples

| Language | Directory | Entry Point |
|----------|-----------|-------------|
| Python | [`python/`](python/) | `python main.py` |
| TypeScript | [`typescript/`](typescript/) | `npx tsx main.ts` |
| PHP | [`php/`](php/) | `php main.php` |

Each example demonstrates:

- **Authentication** — `X-API-Key` header setup
- **Game types** — list available racing categories (Dashing Derby, Platinum Hounds, etc.)
- **Upcoming events** — browse scheduled races with runners and odds
- **Event detail** — runners with draw colors, win/place odds, and form
- **Results** — finishing positions for settled events
- **Markets** — Win, Place, Show, Exacta, Quinella, Trifecta, Head to Head, Odd/Even
- **Cursor pagination** — iterate through pages

## API Overview

```
Base URL: https://virtuals-api.sportlogic.io/api/v1

GET /game-types              Racing categories (horse, greyhound, motor, etc.)
GET /game-types/{id}/info    Game type details
GET /events                  List events (filter by status, game_type_id)
GET /events/{id}             Event detail with runners, odds, form
GET /events/{id}/results     Finishing positions for completed events
GET /markets                 Market types per game type
GET /health                  Health check (no auth required)
```

## Compatibility

Compatible with Kiron Interactive virtual sports format. Drop-in replacement for platforms already integrated with Kiron feeds — same event structure, market types, and settlement flow.

## Event Lifecycle

```
scheduled → started → finished
```

Each game type runs its own cycle of about 9 to 10 minutes. All 8 run at the same
time, so across the feed a settled result lands every 63 seconds. Betting closes
30 seconds before the scheduled start time (`closed_at`).

## Rate Limits

Quota is per day and resets at 00:00 UTC. Unused requests do not carry over.

| Plan | Daily Limit | Price |
|------|-------------|-------|
| Free | 500 | $0 |
| Starter | 15,000 | $59/mo |
| Pro | 50,000 | $109/mo |
| Business | 200,000 | $199/mo |

These are the direct prices, which is what you pay signing up at
[sportlogic.io](https://sportlogic.io). The same API is also on the RapidAPI
marketplace at a higher list price, because the marketplace takes a cut. Buy
wherever suits you; the data, the quotas and the support are the same.
